title: Property build spec
description: Measured shell of one storey, read from a floor plan. Metres; origin = outside north-west corner; +x east (plan right), +z south (plan down), y up; finished floor y = 0. measure_plan.py writes a draft (draft: true, review list); a person/assistant completes rooms, hinge sides, heights and ids; shell/shell.py builds the shell from it. Extra keys are allowed (style, materials, grade, idPrefixes ... are read by other kit parts).

draft.description: true while the spec is a measure_plan.py draft that still needs review

source.description: Where the measurements come from and how pixels map to metres.

footprint.description: [width x, depth z] outside dimensions in metres

interior.description: default for interior walls without their own thickness

outerWalls.description: Axis-aligned outer walls. An x-axis wall runs along x at constant z (north/south); a z-axis wall runs along z (west/east). Corners belong to the x-axis walls: z-axis walls are trimmed to their inner faces by shell.py.

angledWalls.description: Walls at an angle to x and z (shell.py does not build these; the shell modeller hand-models them from this list). Rooms they bound need a polygon.

interiorDoors.description: Defaults for every interior hinged door; an opening's own keys win

leafStyle.description: shaker = two recessed panels (default); slab = flat leaf

leafMaterial.description: material id for the leaf (default m-trim)

hardwareMaterial.description: material id for knobs and roses (default m-brass)

drawnItems.description: Furniture/fixture footprints as drawn: id -> [x1, z1, x2, z2]

line_z_outer.description: x-axis walls: z of the outside face

inner_z.description: x-axis walls: z of the inside face

line_x_outer.description: z-axis walls: x of the outside face

inner_x.description: z-axis walls: x of the inside face

start.description: [x, z] of one end: interior walls the centreline; outer walls the outside face, with the thickness on the side towards the inside of the footprint

openings.description: from/to are distances along the wall from start, not coordinates

from.description: start along the axis; may stop at the face or the centreline of the wall it meets (shell.py snaps to the face)

ends.description: measure_plan.py: what each end met (outer:<side>, interior, free)

from.description: jamb at the smaller coordinate along the wall axis (west or north jamb)

to.description: jamb at the larger coordinate (east or south jamb)

room.description: room the opening serves; interior doors/bifolds open into it

swing.description: free text read by shell.py: 'hinge on|at (the) <north|south|east|west> jamb'; outer doors 'inward'/'outward'; interior 'into <room id or name>'

hinge.description: structured hinge jamb; overrides the swing text

swingSide.description: outer doors: interior|exterior; interior doors/bifolds: the side they open to; overrides room/text

openDeg.description: leaf drawn open this far (default: 90 for outer doors; widest angle <= 90 that clears the walls for interior doors)

foldDeg.description: bifold panel angle out of the wall plane (default: each panel projects <= 0.15 m)

entrance.description: outer door styled as the main entrance (walnut leaf, oak threshold); default when the id contains 'front'

leafStyle.description: interior doors; default spec.interiorDoors.leafStyle, else shaker

hardwareMaterial.description: interior doors: knobs and roses; default spec.interiorDoors.hardwareMaterial, else m-brass

bounds.description: [x1, z1, x2, z2] interior faces (for a polygon room: its bounding box)

polygon.description: [[x, z], ...] interior faces in order, for rooms that are not rectangles (L-shapes, angled walls); floors and ceilings follow it
